chosen.intro: The story of my dark fantasy novel, The Chosen, told through music. Each song follows Mira Roehart as a religious leader takes control of her coastal hometown, turning promises of salvation into a life she must escape.
chosen.sound: This Electrofolk edition preserves the original soundtrack’s lyrics and melodies, adding electronic beats, bass, and textures to its Nordic instrumentation. War drums, pan flutes, and Hardanger fiddles retain the atmosphere of ancient forests and sacred rituals, with an electronic pulse carrying the story forward.
chosen.closing: A companion to the novel and a musical telling of its story, exploring religious control, survival, and the choice to reclaim your life.
chosen.subtitle: A 10-Track Journey Through Faith, Captivity, and the Fight for Freedom

tracks.title: The Light That Swallowed the Silence
tracks.description: Lucien brings Zenith’s faith to Rivenglade, while Mira resists the devotion sweeping through her town.

tracks.title: Mother, Mother
tracks.description: Mira searches for answers about her absent mother and finds belonging in the wild as those around her embrace the new faith.

tracks.title: Too Much Light Will Make You Blind
tracks.description: A supernatural warning clashes with Mira’s loneliness, drawing her toward conversion despite knowing the cost.

tracks.title: Light and Shadow
tracks.description: A duet pits Lucien’s promises of salvation against Mira’s refusal to surrender the wildness within her.

tracks.title: Something Ancient Rises
tracks.description: During baptism, an ancient power in Mira’s blood rejects Lucien’s attempt to take control of her mind.

tracks.title: Forsaken
tracks.description: A family is torn apart as a condemned man’s wife and community turn against him in the name of faith.

tracks.title: Still Water
tracks.description: Forced to marry Lucien to protect her friend, Mira conceals her terror beneath the appearance of a willing bride.

tracks.title: Holy Ghost
tracks.description: Isolated in Lucien’s home, Mira struggles with abuse, dissociation, and the loss of her sense of self.

tracks.title: Run From the Light
tracks.description: At her lowest point, an encounter in the forest awakens her magic and gives her a reason to live—and run.

tracks.title: Into the Unknown Wild
tracks.description: Mira breaks free during an attack on the temple, choosing the dangers of the forest over the captivity she knows.

chosen.intro: An instrumental companion to my dark fantasy novel, The Chosen, following the musical journey of its original soundtrack without lyrics. Each track reflects a stage of Mira Roehart’s story as a religious leader takes control of her hometown and she fights to reclaim her freedom.
chosen.sound: War drums, pan flutes, and Hardanger fiddles create an epic folk sound rooted in Nordic instrumentation. Ancient forests, sacred rituals, and the tension between captivity and escape shape the album’s atmosphere, with instruments carrying the emotion of each scene.
chosen.closing: A wordless companion to the novel, carrying its fear, sorrow, and defiance through the sound of its world.
chosen.subtitle: A 10-Track Journey Through Faith, Captivity, and the Fight for Freedom

tracks.title: The Light That Swallowed the Silence
tracks.description: The arrival of a new faith and the unease beneath its promises.

tracks.title: Mother, Mother

tracks.title: Too Much Light Will Make You Blind

tracks.title: Light and Shadow
tracks.description: The conflict between Lucien’s demand for devotion and Mira’s desire to remain free.

tracks.title: Something Ancient Rises
tracks.description: The power in Mira’s blood awakens against a ritual meant to control her.

tracks.title: Forsaken
tracks.description: A family’s destruction as faith turns love into rejection.

tracks.title: Still Water
tracks.description: The hidden terror of a forced marriage beneath the ceremony’s calm surface.

tracks.title: Holy Ghost

tracks.title: Run From the Light

tracks.title: Into the Unknown Wild

silence.intro: The story of my dark fantasy novel, Blood of the Wild Gods: The Silence, told through music. Each song follows its characters and events as an ancient god awakens, drawing five lives into a struggle against the unmaking of their world.
silence.sound: Celtic and Nordic folk instruments meet electronic bass, melodic rap, layered choirs, and glitch effects, carrying the story from its first whispers to its final battle.
silence.closing: A companion to the novel and a story told through music, about corrupted faith, found family, and what people will give to protect one another.
silence.subtitle: A 15-Track Journey Through Gods, Monsters, and the Cost of Saving the World

tracks.title: The Silent God Awakens (Electrofolk)
tracks.description: An ancient presence stirs, disturbing nature and whispering into five mortal minds.

tracks.title: The Silent God Awakens (Nocturnal)
tracks.description: An alternate musical telling of the opening chapter.

tracks.title: The Silver Hunter
tracks.description: Kaelen discovers the monstrous blood within him connects him to the creatures he hunts.

tracks.title: The Blooming Whisper
tracks.description: Elowen faces the temptation of power beyond healing and the fear of losing herself to it.

tracks.title: The Phoenix Blade
tracks.description: Living in his brother’s shadow, Dain finds his ambition answered by a voice urging him to burn.

tracks.title: The Stray
tracks.description: Young Ryx flees his clan’s sacrificial altar, helped by his mother and hunted by his father.

tracks.title: The Inquisitor
tracks.description: Mordain executes the Bloodmarked, certain his cruelty serves the gods.

tracks.title: A Silent Pact
tracks.description: Three outcasts choose to stand together as Dain turns a kingdom toward tyranny.

tracks.title: Revelations
tracks.description: Mordain discovers his holy crusade has destroyed the very people meant to protect the world.

tracks.title: As the Bards Sing It
tracks.description: A bard’s lament recounts Solara’s fall and the darkness taking possession of its prince.

tracks.title: Trial of Gods
tracks.description: Four companions enter the Awakening Tomb, confronting their deepest fears and the price of victory.

tracks.title: Long Live the Silence
tracks.description: Wearing Dain’s face and crown, the Silent God begins erasing the world.

tracks.title: Even Without Me
tracks.description: Mordain gives a final farewell, choosing to surrender his existence so others can live.

tracks.title: Break the Crown
tracks.description: Kaelen confronts the Silent God, while Elowen fights to save him from his own unleashed power.

tracks.title: Sing Again
tracks.description: The world begins to recover, carrying its losses into a future made possible by sacrifice.
